title: Judah's Conquest and Adoni-Bezek
description: After Joshua's death, Judah and Simeon go to war against the Canaanites. They capture King Adoni-Bezek and cut off his thumbs and big toes. Then they take Jerusalem, Hebron, and Debir, where Caleb gives his daughter Aksah to Othniel as a reward for capturing the city.
